'''''Waq''''' was the name given to a number of [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]] that were used by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Admiral Harkov's fleet|fleet]] when they defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].

They were present when the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory-class)|''Protector'']] was trying to bring in supplies, only to be [[Battle of Ottega|attacked]] by [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] and were destroyed along with the cargo containers
